title: Prepare the Chough 0.6.0 release: Cargo 0.6.0 and the dated CHANGELOG with the dogfood results, and the fixes the dogfood found
description: Prepare the Chough 0.6.0 release: Cargo 0.6.0 and the dated CHANGELOG with the dogfood results, and the fixes the dogfood found
acceptance_criteria: Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock name version 0.6.0, and chough --version prints chough 0.6.0
CHANGELOG.md has a dated [0.6.0] section whose upgrade notes give the dogfood results, and tests/changelog.rs passes
After an in-place migration, the local pointer that names a 0.5.x key resolves to its session through the alias, so next and status read it (D1, red then green)
No test helper is named session_id, so CodeQL rust/cleartext-logging has nothing to flag in the tests
Every live KNOW criterion has an active case linking it with a passing receipt recorded through Chough, so the KNOW gap list of #216 is empty
The #148 bug record is verified through Chough: a red run against the code before #157, then a later green run
Each of the four flaky-test bugs is settled through Chough: fixed and verified, or left open with its diagnostics and named to Leif
The closeout leaves chough doctor clean and every earlier archived story byte-identical

For a second native change on one branch, the gate summary counts only that change's own work since its base_commit (D2, REQ-cli-061, red then green), and #190's merged-main case still counts from the merge base
chough migrate's preview says up front that --apply will refuse while native changes are open, naming them, and still writes nothing (red then green)

answers.constraints: AGENTS.md: SpecSync owns the lifecycle, Chough only its records; the 0.6.0 build only (never the 0.5.0 driver) now that this repository is migrated; no tag, release or merge of #238 without Leif; evidence before change check --commit; a flaky test is never closed just to clear the gate; full suites run on hosted CI
